evidenceExamples.fact: Sluissi with trained Mechanics receive Tech Specialist as a conditional bonus feat. Taking twice the normal Mechanics task time grants +10 circumstance to that Mechanics check. Neither grants a new item upgrade nor changes a published slot count.
evidenceExamples.followup: Trace race→trained skill→granted feat and verify special task-time behavior with current Mechanics/crafting authority before adding runtime rules.

evidenceExamples.name: Near-Human Biotech Augmentation and Cultural Cybernetics
evidenceExamples.fact: Near-Human trait table allows biological augmentation and culturally common cybernetics on the character/species body; not a published generic mod to an ordinary weapon, armor, or non-body device.
evidenceExamples.followup: Route to species/cybernetics design; do not merge with gear upgrade catalogs.

evidenceExamples.name: New melee and ranged weapon tables
evidenceExamples.fact: Explorer Equipment presents new weapons including blastsword and electropole with complete normal weapon identities. Their special effects are inherent to those items, not transferable modifications.
evidenceExamples.followup: Preserve canonical item identities; later weapons audit can reconcile their stats, not create modification slots.

evidenceExamples.name: Tables 2-1 and 2-2, new weapon identities
evidenceExamples.fact: Tables 2-1 and 2-2 supply costs/damage/weight for distinct weapons such as Squib tensor rifle and verpine weaponry, not a catalog of upgrades for other existing items.
evidenceExamples.followup: Weapon production data audit only.

evidenceExamples.name: Table 2-3 Explorer Equipment
evidenceExamples.fact: Published equipment table lists separate sellable items, including Repulsor Hitch, Signal Wand, Microlab, Hypoinjector Wristband and Antidote Synthesizer; costs are for whole items, not installation slot fees.
evidenceExamples.followup: Independent equipment record certification as needed.

evidenceExamples.name: Antidote Synthesizer
evidenceExamples.fact: Given a toxin or poison sample, device produces 1d4 doses in 1d6 rounds; each dose provides +2 to the Treat Injury check to treat that toxin. Source does not say creating doses requires DC20 Treat Injury. Fresh sample needed for more doses.
evidenceExamples.followup: Current medical equipment pack incorrectly adds a DC20 Treat Injury creation check; correct upstream item description in separate gear content pass.

evidenceExamples.name: Hypoinjector Wristband
evidenceExamples.fact: Wristband stores up to eight doses, automatically recognizes harmful substances and administers countermeasure; refill standard action per dose or four rounds for whole set. Power uses two energy cells replaced after five days continuous use.
evidenceExamples.followup: Current medical pack says three doses with a swift-action trigger; source does not establish that as the normal device function. Correct separately.

evidenceExamples.name: Emergency Vacuum Seal
evidenceExamples.fact: Handheld deployed seal patches starship hull breaches and provides conditional response to ship jury-rigging, not an installable enhancement to normal gear.
evidenceExamples.followup: Ship damage/repair authority and stock equipment.

evidenceExamples.name: Personal Multitool
evidenceExamples.fact: Combined handheld utility tool has a retractable vibroblade that can be used as a melee weapon. It is a built-in stock item capability, not permission to add vibroblades to all equipment.
evidenceExamples.followup: Keep tool and weapon function on specific stock equipment identity.

evidenceExamples.name: Repulsor Hitch and externally connected towing rig
evidenceExamples.fact: Separately sold repulsorlift hitch attaches to a cable or similar extension, lifting objects up to 200 kg. The MULE droid may carry one on its chassis; that droid installation belongs in excluded droid refactor. No generic item slot cost or retrofit benefit is published.
evidenceExamples.followup: Potential standalone Repulsor Hitch inventory/catalog entry; do not authorize universal equipment upgrade.

evidenceExamples.name: Signal Wand with optional external power
evidenceExamples.fact: When connected to more powerful energy source, device can send focused subspace beam beyond planet; this is conditional power-supply operation, not a standalone printed upgrade definition or extra universal power-source slot.
evidenceExamples.followup: Keep operation on Signal Wand stock gear if implemented.

evidenceExamples.name: Ancient and Advanced Technology rule reuse
evidenceExamples.fact: Book recommends Legacy-era Antiquated Weapon template for old equipment and Starships Tech Specialist or KOTOR Rakatan Weapon for advanced technology. Ship templates and Antiquated Vehicle are separately mentioned for excluded domains. No new numbers/eligibility supersede their original sources.
evidenceExamples.followup: Keep cross-references to existing tech_specialist, kotor Rakatan and legacy Antiquated IDs rather than duplicate or grant GM narrative bonuses without approval.

Pack says 3 doses and user swift trigger; printed source says up to 8 doses, bioscanner-driven automatic counteragent injection and refill/electric cell rules. Stock gear correction only, not a new modification.

Normally one non-exempt template per item; Prototype, Quick Draw Weapon, and Cortosis/Phrik exempt from this cap. GM may explicitly waive; stacked price adjustments most expensive first, compounded sequentially.

procedures.description: Most weapons and armor can have only one accessory unless GM permits more; every Table 5-6 accessory also carries explicit Scum & Villainy upgrade-slot costs. Both accessory count AND generic slot capacity require checks.

An alternate crystal occupies the focusing crystal choice, replacing personally-built lightsaber ordinary +1 attack bonus; Force bonuses apply only to creator. Crystals are quest items and not for sale. Construction otherwise proceeds normally. Same-effect alternatives are mutually exclusive primary crystal options, not independent stackable effects.

Sith Alchemy: Create Sith Talisman spends one Force Point and a full-round action transforming portable object; one active carried/worn talisman grants +1d6 Force power damage, first use adds 1 DSP, replacement blocked 24h after destroyed.

Sith Alchemy: Create Sith Weapon spends one Force Point and one hour to treat properly prepared weapon, granting Sith Alchemical Weapon template. Dark Side Adept and Dark Side Master are printed prerequisites of Sith Alchemy talent; preserve actual learned-talent check. Template restricted to simple/advanced melee.

Felucian Shaman Infuse Weapon talent: character spends 1 Force Point and full-round action to infuse an unpowered melee weapon. Record infusing actor/weapon identity; conditional object DR and FP attack-hit damage apply only while that actor wields it. No generic slot usage.

Attach 100-credit manual detonator to any explosive, including mines. Requires a Mechanics check to set, using the established explosives setting rules. Successful result permits swift action to detonate within 30 squares. A timed/manual detonator on a mine supersedes normal triggering. No general upgrade-slot cost specified.

Table 4-3 SAMPLE organization benefit for Organization Score 20-29: once per week the credits cost to modify a significant organization item using Tech Specialist is waived. Requires GM-selected organization benefit, appropriate organization relation/significance and remaining weekly use. Does not waive trait prerequisites, Mechanics DC, time or per-item limits; does not create a new trait or upgrade-slot grant.

Military Engineer class feature: standard action, DC 20 Mechanics, create personal melee/ranged weapon with base value <=600 credits x class level, only if proficient; once per encounter. The created weapon gives its creator alone an equipment bonus on attack equal to one-half class level (table shows +1 at level 2, +2 at level 4, etc.). Weapon is destroyed at encounter end, including its temporary Tech Specialist trait when Quick Modifications applies. Grant free energy cell if required. Not a permanent modification or upgrade-slot grant.

Military Engineer Quick Modifications talent, prerequisites Repairs on the Fly and Tech Specialist feat: when creating a field-created weapon, select one EXISTING weapon trait from Tech Specialist (Starships p.21) and apply it at creation. Do not create a duplicate copy of Improved Accuracy, Improved Damage, or Selective Fire in the canonical definition registry; reuse their existing typed weapon definitions, compatible weapon restrictions and provenance. Source does not add an ordinary upgrade-slot cost nor independently require a second Mechanics check/payment. Temporary trait expires with constructed weapon. Reuse Field-Created Weapon class feature authority.

Military Engineer Sabotage Device talent: swift action turns an energy-cell-powered object or weapon into a fragmentation grenade in all ways; a further swift action can restore its original form. Source does not demand Mechanics roll or generic upgrade-slot payment for activation. Object/weapon may be expended by grenade detonation; do not silently restore consumed Item. Typed host domain and operational mode must be retained.

Halo Lamp: Table 5-5 p.65 lists 30 credits and 1 kg. Printed p.66 says bright light in a 3-square radius while lit, remains cool and can attach as a weapon accessory. A linked physical equipment component mounted to a weapon; source does not specify extra crafting cost/skill check, slot charge, installation time or attack bonus. Standalone equipment Item is not a separate new modifier definition.

Trained Mechanics + Biotech Specialist. Each target may normally receive one biotech benefit and no repeated identical benefit. Spend max(1/10 item price,1000 credits); 1 day per 1,000 credits spent; DC20 Mechanics, no Take 10/20 unless Biotech Mastery modifies; failure consumes credits. Only another Biotech Specialist may aid; market value base plus twice total successful modification costs. Excludes vehicle/droid/ship variants of table.

Shaper Biotech Mastery: Biotech Specialist procedures take half the normal time for half the normal cost and permit Take 10 on Mechanics check, even threatened or distracted; cannot Take 20. Apply before transaction, no separate permanent item trait.

Trained Mechanics, tool kit; 1 hour and DC25 Mechanics to graft technology into a biotech device, allowing normal Mechanics and Use Computer applications. It remains biotech and disallows Tech Specialist.

Trained Mechanics + tool kit; 1 hour DC30 Mechanics; host biotech device must already have a technology graft. Connect at most one other DEVICE of size <= host, gaining attached device traits, not new copies. Not weapons or armor; vehicle integration excluded.

The Yuuzhan Vong Biotech template converts eligible technological equipment to biotech equivalents at x4 listed item cost; Rare; biomechanical host must use Treat Injury repair and Biotech Specialist (not Tech Specialist), plus domain-specific armor weight, weapon energy-to-physical damage and device familiarity effects.

Trained Mechanics with tool kit. Replace Antiquated weapon template with Refitted; raw materials 20% of base weapon value (before antiquated template); Medium or smaller 1 day, Large 2, Huge 5, Gargantuan 10, Colossal 20. Multiple trained Mechanics workers can reduce duration by number (max 20), min 1 day. Workday 8 continuous hours. Do not add vehicle/starship size/time scales.

Optional Heirloom Items system. Item present upon fulfillment of Legacy destiny, or qualifying alternative death in pursuit of Destiny; select one of four benefits. Effect persists until Item destruction; cannot purchase as Workbench shop modification. No generic slot price.

Excellent Kit talent: at purchase, qualifying bought weapon/armor/gear gets +50% item HP, +5 object DR and +2 equipment bonus to Mechanics checks by purchaser allies targeting purchased object. Record one item-quality instance, NOT a generic upgrade. Preserve benefit on ownership transfer; do not invent re-purchase.

Only the Finest talent (requires Black Market Buyer): when purchasing black-market goods, may obtain an item already modified with ordinary Tech Specialist feat without increased base item value. Must select source-legal trait for host and preserve its installed instance, not grant blanket free ongoing installations.

Improvised Device: Once/day, 1 hour, Mechanics DC25, produces familiar nonunique equipment up to 200 credits x Improviser class level, excluding Rare/Illegal. Object is destroyed after 24h. Not a permanent Workbench upgrade; any created weapon/armor still has its own typed host legality.

Custom Model (requires Improvised Device talent and Tech Specialist feat): on creating a temporary device, apply one appropriate published Tech Specialist benefit to that device. Does not increase created item value. Reference existing Starships p21 trait IDs, no duplicate canonical trait definitions; temporary device destruction also removes the benefit.

Bigger Bang talent (requires Improvised Device): if the temporary item created is a grenade, increase grenade damage by one die. This is not a transferable universal weapon damage template, and is not an upgrade slot.

Jury-Rigging a Power-Pack Bomb: 2-5 packs, 2 min/Mechanics DC15 (DC10 Tech Specialist); optional timing mechanism requires 30 min/Mechanics DC25 (DC20 Tech Specialist). Normal failure by >=10 detonates instantly; timed-device check failure detonates instantly. After trigger/last dowel charge 1d6 secret GM rounds; burst 2 squares; 2 damage dice per pack; cannot disarm once charging. Source equipment system MUST consume component items and create one disposable device.

Cracken temporary boost to a repulsor sled using a separate power source and tools: 2 minutes, Mechanics DC15/DC10 with Tech Specialist; +2 squares speed OR altitude for 2d4 rounds, then circuitry fails and sled becomes useless pending spare parts. Host classification is unresolved (cargo equipment vs transport/vehicle actor). Store as a research lead ONLY; no general EquipmentSlotAuthority installation or vehicle-domain refactor.
procedures.reasonBlocked: Repulsor sled runtime item classification and effect owner not independently certified

procedures.description: Choose chassis (Table 3-2), focusing crystal (Table 3-3), and eligible accessories before starting Core p40 construction. Apply chassis base Use the Force construction DC plus crystal and any applicable accessory DC modifiers; creator attunes on completion. Standard 7th-level construction threshold. No general slot cost inferred.

Core creator-attunement benefit depends on selected focusing crystal. One active primary focus crystal; substitution replaces normal creator +1 bonus if different benefit. Crystals with effects conditional on attuned wielder must be gated. Do not stack all purchased crystal items or treat their compendium upgradeSlots=1 as generic slot costs.

Dual-phase lightsaber normally has default and extended blade setting. The variant substitutes a second crystal profile for the extended blade setting; swift action switches. Exactly one crystal effect active per setting, no simultaneous benefits; retaining extended blade mechanics and two crystal effects in one mode is prohibited.

At creation, crafter may select one of ten accessories at no additional cost in time or credits. Text says Tech Specialist can add one additional accessory or modification which counts toward the weapon one-modification limit; interaction is not mechanically unambiguous. Do not convert to Scum general-upgrade-slots or permit arbitrary accessory arrays until RAW reconciliation and a single allowance resolver.

Jedi Artisan Masterwork Lightsaber talent lets creator add one extra accessory on construction; damage benefit rerolls one weapon damage die on hit but must take second. Mentoring another builder reduces their Use the Force build DC by 5. This is not equivalent to Tech Specialist trait or ordinary upgrade slots.

Jedi Artisan Quick Modification requires Masterwork Lightsaber. Spend one minute to remove one accessory and install a different accessory on lightsaber the character built; GM may restrict particular physical/rare replacements including electrum detail. Revalidate entitlement, item identity and no duplicate effects.

Requires Sith Alchemy Specialist talent (prerequisite Sith Alchemy). Force Point + one hour uninterrupted work, increase Dark Side Score by 1; normally one benefit per object and no repeat benefit; one modification at a time. Table 1-1 has 4 dark-armor and 3 Sith-weapon traits; exclude 3 Sith-abomination creature traits.

Dark armor chassis is a distinct manufactured armor identity that comes with exactly one Sith Alchemy Specialist trait, not a generic second trait or generic armor slot. Light/medium/heavy are stock variant equipment identities; apply one chosen printed trait with provenance.

Sith Alchemy transforms existing battle armor by corresponding weight to dark armor in 1/2/3 days for light/medium/heavy; pay Force Point at completion and Dark Side Score increment from Sith Alchemy. Produced dark armor has one inherent Alchemy Specialist enhancement as stock identity per p61; no generic upgrade slots.

Sith Alchemy transforms simple or advanced melee weapon (not lightsaber) using Force Point and one hour; wielder can spend Force Point as swift action for Dark Side Score damage bonus on next weapon attack before encounter end and gains +1 DSP. Per-book rules stay separate from KOTOR manufacturer template until verified.

Sith Alchemy creation requires 25,000 credits gems/materials, week of nonconsecutive possible work and Force Point at completion; finished object grants the three Sith Amulet effects printed p68. No item slot cost stated.

Rapid Alchemy uses standard action on wielded melee weapon, gives encounter-long +2 equipment attack; one free-action sacrifice produces +5 equipment bonus on one damage roll. No standard upgrade cost, no printed Force Point requirement.

Geological compressor costs 2,000 credits (licensed); raw materials plus guided process. After 24 hours DC 20 Use the Force, success creates crystal, failure unusable. Cosmetic default crimson with possible other colors; does not grant free additional crystal sockets or general upgrade slots.

Stun Cloak (3,500 credit base) may be doubled in price (7,000 total) to add capabilities of either Core all-temperature cloak or Galaxy at War camouflage poncho. Otherwise cannot take Scum armor upgrades; do not use general slots or attach both alternatives without rule.

A standard cybernetic prosthesis is equipment for Scum optional modification rules, 2 sizes smaller than wearer, with 1 available upgrade slot. Only allowed universal upgrades: Cloaked, Dual Gear, Environmental Sealing, Extra Power Source, Secret Compartment, Storage Capacity; plus Galaxy at War Ion Shielding (1 slot/1,000 credits). Unique cybernetics have 0 slots, cannot reclaim slots, and cannot be modified by this system.

If every installed cybernetic enhancement has ion shielding, character is not considered cybernetically enhanced for purposes of taking ion damage. If even one enhancement lacks shielding there is no benefit. Resolve against installed prosthesis/unique cybernetic inventory; never mislabel as total immunity from ion damage.

Mines placed with full-round action without Mechanics check; attaching time/manual detonator requires Mechanics check following Force Unleashed Campaign Guide pp.100-101 and overrides built-in trigger. Antipersonnel mine tripwire placement DC 10 Mechanics; linking multiple antipersonnel mines costs additional DC 10 Mechanics per mine. This is explosive configuration, not a general equipment upgrade slot.

Detonite cord sold in six-square reels (1,000 credits), multiple reels can be spliced; triggered with timer or manual trigger. Burst radius 1 square from each occupied square, damage 4d6 energy, +5 equipment bonus on Mechanics check to see whether explosion ignores DR of the attached object. Not an ordinary upgrade-slot item. Preserve reel quantity, spatial area and actual trigger source.

Basic: 1 slot, two pieces each one size smaller, 1 full-round reassembly. Deluxe: 2 slots, four pieces each two sizes smaller, 2 full-round reassembly. Each disguised component requires DC30 Perception or DC25 Knowledge (technology) to identify; inventory is one real item with physical components, not cloned independent base items. Printed price unspecified; armor host extension held pending explicit source/eligibility authority.

Flash Suppressor/Silencer costs 400 credits, weighs 0.2 kg; fits over muzzle of Small-or-larger slugthrower, imposes -10 to observer Perception checks to hear or see the shot, reduces maximum weapon range by 2 range increments. No printed slot charge/mounting action; treat as physical accessory, not generic free zero-slot upgrade. Not blaster-only.

Holo Converter is standalone 3,000-credit, 2-kg accessory attached to holoprojector. Configured with up to 10 false personae including altered species, gender and voice. Grants +5 equipment bonus on Deception to make remote receiver believe user is someone else. Source does not specify any generic upgrade-slot charge or automatic in-person Deception bonus.

Outlaw Tech (Scoundrel) Personalized Modifications talent. Standard action to tune a powered weapon currently wielded; for remainder of encounter actor gains +1 equipment bonus on attacks and +2 equipment bonus on damage with THAT weapon. No Tech Specialist feat or Mechanics check specified for this talent; no general upgrade slot or permanent item mutation.
